bio_en:
Ms. Chan is the founder and principal solicitor of Chan Ching Man & Co.

Ms. Chan obtained her Bachelor of Laws (LLB) at The University of Hong Kong and was admitted as a solicitor in Hong Kong in 2010. To expand her professional experience, she established her own firm in 2016 where she gives practical legal solutions to clients. Prior to founding Chan Ching Man & Co., Ms. Chan was trained and worked in a reputed and time-honored local law firm in the general practice.

Ms. Chan is committed to provide various kinds of dispute resolution services, whether via litigation, mediation and arbitration, Ms. Chan sought to resolve the dispute is the most time and costs efficient way.

Through more than 15 years of practice, Ms. Chan has developed extensive experience in representing and advising corporate and individual clients on various kinds of commercial and civil disputes including asset tracing and recovery, trademark, land, landlord and tenant, contract, shareholders, director's duties, tort, matrimonial and family, employment, personal injuries, estate administration, enforcement of award or judgment, interim measures or injunction application etc. Ms. Chan also has experience in handling criminal defence and appeal in all levels of Courts.

In terms of non-contentious matters, Ms. Chan provides advice and handles cases on conveyancing transactions, tenancy, probate and will, employment, company, compliance issues, data privacy, commercial agreements.

Ms. Chan's clients come from across the globe other than local individuals, corporations (private or listed), institution and foreign high-net-worth individuals and corporations and advises on cross-border litigation or arbitration matters across Hong Kong, Mainland China and international markets.

Ms. Chan is a civil celebrant of marriage and has celebrated a number of marriages. She is also accredited family mediator who has successfully resolved family disputes amicably by mediation.

Ms. Chan's philosophy in her legal work is to provide clients with professional advice, practical and effective solutions, in order to assist clients to solve their problems, and most importantly, manage their risks before crisis arises.

Ms. Chan reads and writes Chinese and English, speaks Cantonese, English and Mandarin.
bio_cn:
陳靜文律師為陳靜文律師行的創辦人兼首席律師。

陳律師畢業於香港大學並獲頒法學士（LLB）學位，於 2010 年獲認許為香港執業律師。為進一步拓展專業領域，陳律師於 2016 年創立陳靜文律師行，致力為客戶提供切實可行的法律方案。創立本行前，陳律師曾於一家歷史悠久且享負盛名的本地全科律師行接受培訓及執業。

陳律師致力提供多元化的爭議解決服務；無論透過訴訟、調解或仲裁，均秉持以最具時間與成本效益的方式為客戶化解紛爭。

憑藉逾十五年的執業歷練，陳律師在代表企業及個人客戶處理各類商業與民事爭議方面積累了深厚經驗，範疇涵蓋：資產追蹤與追討、商標、土地、業主與租客、合約、股東爭議、董事責任、侵權、婚姻及家事法、勞資糾紛、人身傷害、遺產管理、仲裁裁決或判決之執行，以及申請臨時處分或禁制令等。此外，陳律師亦具備豐富經驗處理各級法院的刑事辯護與上訴案件。

在非訴訟法律事務方面，陳律師為各類案件提供專業法律意見及辦理相關手續，包括物業轉讓買賣、租務、遺囑與遺產承辦、僱傭事務、公司法務、合規諮詢、個人資料私隱及各類商業合約。

陳律師的客戶網絡遍及本地及全球，涵蓋個人、私人企業、上市公司、各類機構，以至海外高淨值人士及跨國企業；並經常就涉及香港、中國內地及國際市場的跨境訴訟與仲裁事宜提供策略性法律諮詢。

陳律師亦為香港婚姻監禮人，具備主持各類婚禮的豐富經驗；同時亦是認可家事調解員，曾多次透過調解協助客戶以和平協商的方式圓滿化解家庭爭議。

陳律師的執業理念在於提供精闢專業的法律意見與切實高效的解決方案，不僅協助客戶迎刃化解當前法律難題，更關鍵在於防患未然，在危機爆發前為客戶做好全面的風險管理。

陳律師精通中文及英文書寫；能操流利粵語、英語及普通話。

bio_en:
Leon is a solicitor admitted in Hong Kong. He obtained his Graduate Diploma in Law from the University of the West of England and his Postgraduate Certificate in Laws (PCLL) from The University of Hong Kong. Prior to entering the legal profession, he gained valuable commercial and administrative experience with international professional firms and listed companies.

Leon's practice focuses on civil and commercial litigation, dispute resolution and arbitration. He has extensive experience handling a broad range of contentious matters, including contractual disputes, property ownership disputes, family asset disputes, landlord and tenant disputes, adverse possession claims, matrimonial proceedings, personal injury actions and contentious probate matters. His experience also covers debt recovery actions, including loan/mortgage enforcement proceedings, various criminal proceedings and appeals.

In addition to his contentious practice, Leon advises on non-contentious matters, including conveyancing, wills and probate, estate administration, wealth and succession planning, and tenancy agreements.

Throughout his practice, Leon has acted for a diverse spectrum of clients, ranging from private individuals and families to high-net-worth individuals, landlords and property owners. His notable experience includes representing prominent landlords in commercial tenancy matters involving substantial properties in well-known developments in Hong Kong, as well as handling highly complex disputes concerning beneficial ownership of properties, family trusts, contentious probate, convertible share agreements involving listed companies, long-term tenancies and enforcement of judgment debts.

Leon adopts a practical and commercially minded approach to legal practice, focusing on delivering effective and proportionate solutions tailored to his clients' needs. He is experienced in litigation strategy, settlement negotiations and mediation, with a view to resolving disputes efficiently while safeguarding his clients' interests.

Leon is fluent in English, Cantonese and Mandarin.
bio_cn:
趙英安律師為香港執業律師，於西英格蘭大學（University of the West of England, Bristol）法律深造文憑（Graduate Diploma in Law），並取得香港大學法學專業證書（PCLL）。在投身法律界之前，趙英安律師曾於國際知名專業機構及上市公司任職，累積了商業及行政管理方面的實務經驗。

趙英安律師的法律業務集中於民事及商業訴訟、爭議解決及仲裁。他在處理各類爭議性案件方面具備豐富經驗，包括合約糾紛、物業業權爭議、家族資產糾紛、業主與租客爭議、逆權侵佔、婚姻訴訟、人身傷害索償及具爭議性的遺產訴訟等。其執業範疇亦涵蓋債務追討，包括貸款及按揭執行訴訟，以及各類刑事訴訟及上訴案件。

除訴訟業務外，趙英安律師亦就各類非訴訟法律事務提供意見及服務，包括物業轉易、遺囑及遺產承辦、遺產管理、財富及傳承規劃，以及租賃協議等。

趙英安律師曾為不同背景及需求的客戶提供法律服務，客戶涵蓋一般個人及家庭、高資產淨值人士、業主及物業持有人。他曾代表知名業主處理涉及香港大型及著名物業發展項目的商業租賃事宜，亦曾處理多宗高度複雜的法律爭議，包括物業實益擁有權、家族信託、具爭議性的遺產訴訟、涉及上市公司的可換股股份協議糾紛、長期租賃爭議，以及判定債項的強制執行等。

趙英安律師處理法律事務時，著重務實及商業角度，致力按客戶的實際需要提供有效及相稱的法律解決方案。他在訴訟策略、和解談判及調解方面具備豐富經驗，致力在保障客戶權益的同時，以具成本效益的方式妥善解決爭議。

趙英安律師能操流利英語、粵語及普通話。

bio_en:
Alex joined our firm as a Trainee Solicitor in July 2022 and was admitted as a Solicitor of the High Court of Hong Kong in October 2024. Currently an Associate with the firm, he brings four years of diverse experience in the legal industry.

Alex holds a Bachelor of Laws (LLB) from the University of Kent and a Master of Laws (LLM) in Intellectual Property Law from Queen Mary University of London. He subsequently completed his Postgraduate Certificate of Laws (PCLL) at the City University of Hong Kong.

Prior to joining our firm, Alex gained his first exposure to the legal industry during his two-year tenure at a global provider of legal information solutions. In this capacity, he delivered over 200 bilingual legal research training workshops to a broad spectrum of legal professionals, including international and local law firms, independent barristers, corporate in-house legal departments, government counsels, and academic institutions. He also actively contributed to the internal research and development of market-leading online legal research platforms widely utilized by Hong Kong legal practitioners in their daily practice.

Alex possesses a robust litigation and dispute resolution practice, with specialized expertise across family law, property disputes, commercial asset recovery, and international arbitration:

Matrimonial & Family Law: Experienced in handling comprehensive family law proceedings, including consent applications, ancillary relief, and children matters.
Property Disputes: Advised on property disputes, with specific experience handling water leakage claims and building management disputes.
Debt Recovery & Civil Fraud: Proven track record in high-value debt collection, asset tracing, and multi-jurisdictional fraud recovery.
Arbitration & Cross-Border Applications: Experienced in institutional arbitration and court applications brought in support of international arbitration proceedings.
Personal Injury & Medical Negligence: Advised private clients on tortious liability, personal injury actions, and medical negligence claims.

Alex advises a diverse portfolio of institutional and private clients on complex cross-border litigation matters across Hong Kong, Mainland China, and international markets. His practice focuses on representing Hong Kong, Mainland Chinese, and foreign high-net-worth individuals and corporations, which include but are not limited to Australian superannuation funds, a BVI company owned by members of a high-net-worth family in Hong Kong, a Singapore subsidiary of a global elastomers distributor headquartered in Luxembourg, a Russian state-owned special purpose vehicle, an Arab wholesale trading conglomerate specializing in the international distribution of petrochemical materials and crude oil, and a major national commercial bank in Mainland China.

Alex is proficient in English, Cantonese, and Mandarin.
bio_cn:
李旻軒律師於 2022 年 7 月加入本行擔任實習律師，並於 2024 年 10 月獲認許為香港高等法院執業律師。他現為本所助理律師，在法律行業擁有四年的多元化經驗。

李旻軒律師持有英國肯特大學（University of Kent）法律學士學位（LLB）及英國倫敦大學瑪麗王后學院（Queen Mary University of London）知識產權法法律碩士學位（LLM），隨後於香港城市大學取得法學專業證書（PCLL）。

在加入本行之前，李旻軒律師在一家領先的全球法律資訊方案供應商任職兩年，初次涉足法律行業。在此期間，他為廣泛的法律專業人士舉辦了 200 多場雙語法律檢索培訓工作坊，對象包括國際及本地律師事務所、大律師、企業內部法律顧問、政府律師以及學術機構等。此外，他亦積極參與市場領先的線上法律檢索平台的內部研究與開發，該等平台現已廣為香港法律從業員於日常實務中應用。

擁有穩健的訴訟與爭議解決執業經驗，並在家事法、物業爭議、商業資產追收及國際仲裁領域具備專業知識：

婚姻及家事法：在處理全面的家事法法律程序方面經驗豐富，包括同意申請、附屬濟助及子女相關事宜。
物業爭議：曾就物業爭議提供法律顧問服務，並在處理滲水索償及大廈管理爭議方面具備專門經驗。
債務追收及民事欺詐：在高額債務催收、資產追查及跨國欺詐追收方面擁有廣受認可的往績紀錄。
仲裁及跨境申請：在機構仲裁及為支持國際仲裁程序而向法院提出的申請方面具備經驗。
人身傷害及醫療疏忽：曾就侵權責任、人身傷害訴訟及醫療疏忽索償向私人客戶提供法律意見。

李旻軒律師精通英語、廣東話（粵語）及普通話。

bio_en:
John obtained his Graduate Diploma in English and Hong Kong Law (Common Professional Examination) and Bachelor of Laws from the Manchester Metropolitan University before obtaining his Postgraduate Certificate of Laws from the University of Hong Kong.

Prior to joining our firm as a trainee solicitor, John served the Correctional Services Department for more than 10 years with experience in handling civil litigation cases including personal injury, judicial review, habeas corpus and small claim matters and providing statutory supervision to persons released from Detention Centre and Post-Release Supervision of Prisoners Scheme and compiling of pre-sentencing suitability reports.

John became a qualified solicitor in 2026 after two years of training with our firm. Since John joined the private practice of the legal profession, John gained extensive experience in representing clients at various stages of criminal defence and at all levels of court, including attending legal visits at law enforcement agencies, bail applications, trials, pleas in mitigations, appeals and other plea bargain negotiations.

In terms of civil and commercial litigation, John established experience in handling various kinds of cases including recourse against arbitral award, applications for interim measures including injunctions, commercial or civil fraud, asset recovery, enforcement of local or foreign judgment, contractual disputes, bankruptcy and companies' winding up.

John has also extended his practice in conveyancing, employment, wills and probate, family dispute and personal injuries dispute.

John has provided service to both individuals and corporations including foreign law firms.

John possesses a robust litigation and dispute resolution practice, with specialized expertise across civil law, real estate disputes, commercial asset recovery, and international arbitration. His representative track record includes:

HCA 809/2024 – represented a PRC bank enforcing a RMB 490 million mainland judgment and successfully obtained Mareva injunction based on common law enforcement of a PRC judgment
HCA 1211/2018 – represented a high net worth individual and successfully obtained judgment in her favour with costs on an indemnity basis
HCA 1662/2020 – represented the lay client and successfully obtained order to discontinue proceedings against the lay client with no order as to costs
HCMP 1705/2025 – represented a local company and successfully obtained injunction against a PRC company from presenting winding-up petition

John reads and writes Chinese and English, speaks Cantonese, English and Mandarin.
bio_cn:
在香港大學獲得法學專業證書前，尹國鈞律師在曼徹斯特都會大學分別獲得英格蘭及香港法律深造文憑及法律學士學位。

加入本行擔任實習律師之前，尹國鈞律師曾在懲教署工作10年，擁有處理民事訴訟案件的豐富經驗，包括人身傷害、司法覆核、人身保護令及小額錢債事宜，並負責為從勞教中心及監管釋囚計劃下釋放的人士提供善後輔導監管服務，以及撰寫判前評估適合性報告。

從香港大學獲得法學專業證書後，尹國鈞律師正式於2023年11月加入本行擔任實習律師，於本行完成兩年實習律師培訓，並於2026年獲得香港律師資格。

自尹國鈞律師投身私人執業後，他在刑事辯護方面累積了豐富經驗，曾於各級法院及不同訴訟階段代表客戶，包括到執法機構進行法律探訪、保釋申請、審訊、求情、上訴，以及其他答辯商討。

在民事及商業訴訟方面，尹國鈞律師處理過各類案件，包括就仲裁裁決的追訴、非正審申請（包括禁制令）、商業或民事欺詐、資產追回、執行本地或外地判決、合約爭議、破產及公司清盤等。尹國鈞律師亦將業務擴展至物業轉讓、僱傭、遺囑及遺產承辦、婚姻事務爭議及人身傷害爭議等範疇。

尹國鈞律師曾為個人客戶及公司客戶（包括外地律師行）提供法律服務。

尹國鈞律師擁有豐富的訴訟和爭議解決經驗，尤其擅長家庭法、房地產糾紛、商業資產追回和國際仲裁。他的代表性案例包括代表一家內地銀行，申請執行一項人民幣4.9億元的內地判決，並成功根據普通法執行內地判決的原則，取得資產凍結令；代表一位高淨值人士，成功取得判決，並獲法庭頒令對方以彌償基準支付訟費；代表當事人成功申請中止針對當事人的訴訟程序，並獲法庭頒令訟費不作命令；及代表一家本地公司成功取得禁制令禁止一家內地公司提出清盤呈請。

尹國鈞律師閱讀及書寫中文及英文，說廣東話、英文及普通話。

bio_en:
Mr. Lee has worked in the legal industry for over 11 years. He joined our firm in 2016 since established and holds a Advanced Diploma in Legal Studies from the School of Professional and Continuing Education of the University of Hong Kong (HKU SPACE).

He is primarily responsible for legal research, file and case management, as well as drafting and reviewing a broad range of correspondence, legal documents.

Mr. Lee possesses extensive experience handling civil and criminal litigation across all levels of courts in Hong Kong. His civil expertise spans employees' compensation (work injury) claims, personal injury claims (such as traffic accidents, slips and falls), divorce proceedings, bankruptcy proceedings, commercial debt and invoice recovery, cross-border probate, and water leakage disputes. In terms of criminal litigation, he has handled cases involving traffic offences (including careless driving, dangerous driving, and drink driving), money laundering, drug offences, forgery of false documents, employment of illegal workers, customs smuggling, and doxxing offences under the purview of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data.

To date, Mr. Lee has actively handled and assisted in over 500 litigation cases, including more than 300 personal injuries and employees' compensation claims, 100 criminal cases, and numerous contentious civil and commercial matters.

Mr. Lee is dedicated, analytical, and results-oriented, committed to delivering strategic and effective legal support tailored to each client's specific needs.

Mr. Lee is fluent in Cantonese, English, and Mandarin.
bio_cn:
李泫錞先生在法律界擁有超過 11 年的工作經驗。他自本律師行於 2016 年創立起便加入，並持有香港大學專業進修學院（HKU SPACE）法律高等文憑。

他主要負責法律研究、檔案及案件管理，以及起草與審閱各類往來信件和法律文件。

李泫錞先生在處理香港各級法院的民事及刑事訴訟方面擁有豐富經驗。在民事領域，其專長涵蓋僱員補償（工傷）索償、人身傷害索償（如交通意外、滑倒跌傷等）、離婚程序、破產呈請、商業債務與發票追討、跨區域遺產承辦，以及樓宇漏水糾紛。在刑事訴訟方面，他曾處理涉及交通罪行（包括不小心駕駛、危險駕駛及酒後駕駛）、洗黑錢、毒品罪行、偽造虛假文書、聘用非法勞工、海關走私，以及屬於個人資料私隱專員公署管轄範疇的起底罪行等案件。

截至目前為止，李泫錞先生已積極處理並協助跟進超過 500 宗訴訟案件，當中包括逾 300 宗人身傷害及僱員補償索償、100 宗刑事案件，以及多宗具爭議性的民商事爭議。

李泫錞先生工作熱誠專注、善於分析且注重實效，致力根據每位客戶的具體需求，提供具策略性且切實有效的法律支援。

bio_en:
Mr. Kwong has worked in the legal industry for over 30 years. Mr. Kwong joined our firm in 2021 as a Legal Executive. He obtained his Diploma in Legal Studies from the University of Hong Kong, School of Professional and Continuing Education (HKU SPACE) in 2009, and was admitted as a Legal Executive in the same year.

He is primarily responsible for legal research, file and case management, client representation, as well as drafting and reviewing a broad range of legal documents and correspondence.

Mr. Kwong possesses extensive experience handling civil and criminal litigation across all levels of courts in Hong Kong, including the Magistrates' Court, District Court, High Court, and various appellate courts.

In terms of civil and commercial litigation, his expertise spans contractual disputes, shareholders' disputes, breach of directors' duties, debt recovery, employment disputes, personal injuries, employees' compensation, bankruptcy and insolvency matters, as well as land and property issues (including landlord and tenant disputes, adverse possession, and building management disputes). Further, he excels in family law matters, such as divorce, child care, custody, ancillary relief, and financial settlements.

In criminal law, he has extensive defence experience handling a broad range of offences, including theft, fraud and deception, assault and wounding, sexual offences, access to computer with dishonest intent, dangerous driving, trafficking in dangerous drugs, money laundering, false trademark, and import and export offences.

To date, Mr. Kwong has actively handled and represented clients in over 3,500 litigation matters, including more than 2,000 civil, commercial, and family cases, as well as over 1,500 criminal cases across various court levels.

Mr. Kwong is dedicated, meticulous, and effective legal support tailored to each client's specific needs.

Mr. Kwong is fluent in Cantonese, English, and Mandarin.
bio_cn:
鄺天狄先生投身法律行業逾30年。他於2021年加入本行擔任法律行政人員。他於2009年獲香港大學專業進修學院（HKU SPACE）頒發法律研究文憑，並於同年獲認可為法律行政人員。

他主要負責法律研究、案件及檔案管理、代表客戶處理事務，以及起草和審閱各類法律文件與往來函件。

鄺天狄先生在處理香港各級法院的民事及刑事訴訟方面擁有豐富經驗，包括裁判法院、區域法院、高等法院以及各級上訴法院。在民商事訴訟範疇，他的專業領域涵蓋合約糾紛、股東爭議、違反董事信託責任、追討債務、勞資糾紛、人身傷亡、僱員補償（工傷）、破產及清盤事宜，以及土地與物業糾紛（包括業主與租客爭議、逆權侵佔和物業管理糾紛）。此外，他精通婚姻家事法各類事宜，如離婚、子女撫養、管養權、附屬濟助及財產分配等。

在刑事方面，他具備豐富的辯護經驗，處理過各類罪行，包括但不限於盜竊、欺詐及騙案、普通襲擊及傷人、性罪行、不誠實取用電腦、危險駕駛、販運危險藥物、洗黑錢、虛假商標以及進出口相關罪行。

迄今為止，鄺天狄先生已積極處理並代表客戶處理超過3,500宗訴訟案件，當中包括逾2,000宗民事、商事及家事案件，以及在各級法院審理的1,500多宗刑事案件。

鄺天狄先生工作專注熱誠，致力因應每位客戶的具體需求，提供具策略性且高效的法律支援。

bio_en:
Mr. Ng holds a bachelor's degree in law and business. Launching his professional career into the legal industry upon graduation, he brings three years of dedicated post-graduate experience to our firm. Since joining in September 2023, Mr. Ng has established himself as a capable and integral member of the team, working closely with our solicitors to deliver end-to-end case management and responsive legal support. Mr. Ng provided full spectrum of legal support, worked closely with solicitors, liaised with various counter parties and authorities, and communicated with clients.

Mr. Ng's experience and practice established in civil and criminal litigation for all levels of Court, and recently extended to conveyancing transactions, and assisted in Wang Fuk Court property sales project.
